headings.usage: Page titles, Metric numbers, Section headers

body.usage: General text, form labels, small text

mono.usage: Tracking IDs, bar codes, numeric data

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Mobile-first, high density utility. App-like layout spanning max-w-md mx-auto. Use 'Control Room' grid philosophy for metrics.
layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen pb-20 bg-background relative shadow-2xl
layout_and_spacing.surface_strategy: Grid Borders and Flat Solid. Sharp, functional containers.

bottom_navigation.style: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md mx-auto bg-white border-t-2 border-gray-200 z-50 flex justify-around py-3 pb-safe

cards.style: bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 transition-all relative overflow-hidden

inputs.style: w-full h-12 border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-4 font-body text-gray-900 focus:border-[#FF5A00] focus:ring-0 outline-none transition-colors
inputs.label: block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1.5

buttons.primary: w-full flex items-center justify-center bg-[#FF5A00] text-white h-12 rounded-lg font-bold text-base hover:bg-[#E04F00] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all
buttons.secondary: w-full flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-100 text-gray-900 h-12 rounded-lg font-bold text-base hover:bg-gray-200 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all
buttons.outline: w-full flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-gray-200 text-gray-700 h-12 rounded-lg font-bold text-base hover:border-[#FF5A00] hover:text-[#FF5A00] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all

status_badges.delivered: inline-flex items-center bg-green-100 text-green-700 font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs uppercase tracking-wider
status_badges.pending: inline-flex items-center bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs uppercase tracking-wider

scanner_ui.container: relative bg-black rounded-lg aspect-square w-full overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center shadow-inner
scanner_ui.laser: absolute top-1/2 left-0 w-full h-[2px] bg-[#FF5A00] shadow-[0_0_12px_#FF5A00] animate-pulse

motion_and_interactions.active: Press-down effect (scale-[0.98]) on buttons for physical feedback.
motion_and_interactions.page_transition: Simple fade-in or slide-in from right for new views.

icons_and_assets.instructions: Use Lucide React icons. Use bold stroke weights (strokeWidth={2.5}) for a utilitarian, highly legible look.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React.js application using Tailwind CSS, structured to look and act like a Mobile App (React Native/Expo equivalent).
Constrain the main layout to 'max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-gray-50' with a fixed bottom navigation bar.
Data-testid attributes MUST be applied to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, list items) using kebab-case role-based names.
All components must be written in Javascript (.js, .jsx), not Typescript.
Include a dynamic Barcode generation using a library like 'react-barcode' for the Label Print views.
Implement clear toggle states for WhatsApp messaging and COD/Prepaid options.
Shipment tracking IDs should use the auto-increment logic visibly (e.g., highlighting '580', '581'). Use JetBrains Mono for tracking numbers.
For shipping label generation, ensure accurate A4 layout dividing (1, 2, or 4 per page) and a dedicated Thermal layout view.
Ensure high contrast across all elements. Avoid soft shadows; use solid 2px borders.
